/* Baim02Mapper.selectCompCmmCodeDList */ SELECT '' AS chk , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.BAIM_VAL_CD AS baimValCd , B.BAIM_VAL_D_CD AS baimValDCd , B.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS baimValDNm , B.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx , B.USE_YN AS useYn , B.VAL_D_INFO_1 AS valDInfo1 , B.VAL_D_INFO_2 AS valDInfo2 , B.VAL_D_DESC AS valDDesc FROM TB_BAIM_VAL_M A INNER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.BAIM_VAL_CD = B.BAIM_VAL_CD AND (B.VAL_D_INFO_1 IS NULL OR B.VAL_D_INFO_1 != 'manage') /* 관리 코드는 조회 제외 */ AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.BAIM_VAL_CD = #{codeCd} ORDER BY B.SORT_IDX
